KAS Luxury Auction

KAS Luxury Auction

Part of Al Sheikh Investment Group

KAS Luxury Auction specialises in online auctions and private sales of luxury assets. Our scope includes designer handbags, fine jewellery, luxury watches and rare collectibles.

The business connects buyers and sellers through its global network, with live auctions and private events forming part of the experience. Contact the team for current opportunities.
